profile.name: FTDI USB转串口适配器
profile.description: 基于 FTDI/FT232 芯片的 USB 转串口接口设备，用于在计算机与采用 UART/TTL 串行通信的实验仪器、微控制器或自制电子模块之间传输数据。部分型号还可通过 CBUS 引脚实现简单的数字输出与输入读取，常用于实验室中的串口通信、设备调试和基础 I/O 控制。
profile.description_en: A USB-to-serial interface device based on FTDI/FT232 chips, used to transfer data between a computer and laboratory instruments, microcontrollers, or custom electronics that communicate over UART/TTL serial links. Some models also expose CBUS pins for simple digital output and input reading, making them useful for serial communications, instrument debugging, and basic I/O control in the lab.
